global.description: Global configuration block (YAML snippet). Typically left empty or used for metadata like version or environment tag.

cluster.enabled.description: Enable clustering mode. When false, GarageMQ runs as a standalone node.

items.description: Host:port of seed nodes used for cluster discovery (e.g., garage-node1:4001).

cluster.seed_nodes.description: List of known GarageMQ nodes to contact for cluster bootstrap.

cluster.node_name.description: Unique node name for this instance (e.g., garage@node1). Must match Erlang node naming convention if clustering.

cluster.cookie.description: Erlang distribution cookie used for node authentication. Must be identical across all cluster nodes.

cluster.join_retry_interval_sec.description: Interval (seconds) between retries when joining a cluster.

listener.host.description: IP address to bind the MQTT listener to.

listener.port.description: TCP port for unencrypted MQTT connections.

listener.max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous MQTT client connections.

listener.tls.enabled.description: Enable TLS for MQTT connections on the main listener.

listener.tls.cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format).

listener.tls.key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format).

listener.tls.ca_file.description: Optional path to CA certificate bundle for client certificate verification (PEM format).

path.description: Required for 'file' provider: path to YAML/JSON users file.

url.description: Required for 'http' provider: URL for auth HTTP callback.

method.description: HTTP method for auth callback ('POST' or 'GET').

username_field.description: Field name in request body containing the username.

password_field.description: Field name in request body containing the password.

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS for outbound HTTP auth requests.

ca_file.description: Path to CA cert for LDAPS verification (optional).

bind_dn.description: DN to bind as for user search (optional for anonymous bind).

user_filter.description: LDAP filter to locate user entry (e.g., '(uid={username})').

cert_file.description: Path to client cert for LDAPS (optional).

key_file.description: Path to client key for LDAPS (optional).

jwks_uri.description: URL of JWKS endpoint to fetch signing keys.

username_claim.description: JWT claim to use as username (e.g., 'sub' or 'email').

auth.providers.description: List of authentication provider configurations. One or more providers may be defined.

storage.data_dir.description: Directory for persistent storage (messages, sessions, subscriptions).

storage.max_segment_size_mb.description: Maximum size (MB) of a single data segment before compaction.

storage.compaction_threshold.description: When ratio of obsolete data exceeds this value, compaction is triggered.

storage.sync_write.description: Force sync writes to disk for durability (slower but safer).

log.file_path.description: Path to log file (only used if log.output = 'file').

log.max_size_mb.description: Maximum size (MB) per rotated log file.

log.max_backups.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

log.compress.description: Compress rotated log files with gzip.

metrics.port.description: Port to expose the /metrics endpoint on.

metrics.enable_histograms.description: Enable histogram metrics for latency (increases cardinality).

items.description: Duration bucket boundaries (in seconds) for histograms.

limits.max_inflight_messages.description: Maximum number of QoS 1/2 messages in-flight per client.

limits.queue_depth_warning_threshold.description: Queue depth at which a warning is logged (for slow clients or offline storage).

limits.session_expiry_sec.description: Default session expiry interval (seconds) after client disconnect.

defaults.subscription.max_topic_levels.description: Maximum topic levels (depth) allowed in a subscription filter.

defaults.subscription.max_wildcards_per_.description: Maximum number of wildcards (+ or #) allowed per topic filter.
